title: Security
subtitle: Two-step sign-in and the devices where you're signed in.

forced.title: Turn on two-step sign-in to continue
forced.body: A super admin requires two-step sign-in for every admin. Set it up below; the rest of the Admin Panel opens as soon as it's on.

twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.onBody_one: On since {{date}}. Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app. {{count}} backup code left.
twoStep.onBody_other: On since {{date}}. Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app. {{count}} backup codes left.
twoStep.offBody: Add a second step to signing in: a 6-digit code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. Someone with your password alone can't get in.
twoStep.fewCodes_one: Only {{count}} backup code left. Make new ones so you aren't locked out if you lose your phone.
twoStep.fewCodes_other: Only {{count}} backup codes left. Make new ones so you aren't locked out if you lose your phone.
twoStep.turnOffBody: Signing in will only need your password. Enter it to confirm.
twoStep.newCodesBody: Your old backup codes stop working. Enter your password to make ten new ones.

setup.title: Turn on two-step sign-in
setup.intro: Use an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
setup.openApp: On this phone? Open in your authenticator app
setup.backupIntro: Keep these backup codes somewhere safe, away from your phone. Each one signs you in once if your phone isn't with you. They won't be shown again.
setup.saveFirst: Download or copy the codes to finish.
setup.fileTitle: GoMingle Admin: backup codes for two-step sign-in
setup.fileNote: Each code works once. Keep this file somewhere safe.
setup.scan: Scan this code with the app. Can't scan? Add an account in the app, choose to enter a setup key and type the key below. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.qrAlt: QR code to add GoMingle Admin to your authenticator app

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.body: Sign out any device you don't recognise or no longer use. It stops working straight away.
sessions.viaBackup: signed in with a backup code

policy.title: Require two-step sign-in for every admin
policy.body: Admins without it must set it up before they can use the Admin Panel. If someone loses their phone, reset it for them on the Users page.
policy.needOwn: Turn on two-step sign-in for your own account first.
policy.nowRequired: Two-step sign-in is now required for every admin.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.wrongCode: That code didn't match. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
